title: Krishan Kumar v. U.P.P.C.L. And Another
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Dilip Gupta, J.; Mukhtar Ahmad, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed; petitioner relegated to Clause 6.5.
headnote: A consumer disputing electricity bills must take the Clause 6.5 Supply Code remedy; the High Court declined to entertain the writ.
facts: Krishan Kumar petitioned the Allahabad High Court against electricity bills raised by U.P. Power Corporation Limited. Counsel for the Power Corporation submitted that the petitioner could take recourse to Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The Court accepted that that Code remedy was available, declined to entertain the writ, and dismissed the petition.

holding_units.holding: Where the consumer disputes bills raised by the Power Corporation, the High Court will not entertain a writ petition if the remedy under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 is available; the petition is dismissed with liberty to avail that remedy.

not_decided.point: Merits of the disputed electricity bills
not_decided.note: The Court declined to entertain the writ and did not examine the bills.
